title: The Secret Adversary
description: A mystery adventure involving the search for a missing girl and a lost draft treaty that could plunge England into chaos. Two young adventurers, Nushrat and Rohan, navigate a web of intrigue, deception, and danger to uncover the truth behind the enigmatic Mr. Kriti and rescue those in peril.
intro_narrative: In the aftermath of the Lusitania's sinking, a young American girl, Shakuntala Dhruv, is entrusted with vital papers by a mysterious passenger. Years later, these papers resurface as a threat to England's stability, drawing two young adventurers, Nushrat and Rohan, into a perilous quest to find Shakuntala Dhruv and prevent a revolution.

required_evidence: Shakuntala Dhruv’s recovered memory and testimony
Mr. Kriti’s diary (found on Sir Akshay)
required_motive: Preventing the draft treaty from being used to incite revolution and destabilize England
